text.name: Annexation of Crimea
text.rules: Record "borders redrawn". SAE spends 3 points. At the end of this turn, LIO spends 1 point.
text.history: Russian forces took control of Crimea in late February 2014; after a referendum on 16 March 2014 Russia annexed the peninsula on 18 March, and the UN General Assembly declared the referendum invalid on 27 March 2014.
